A3Analogue

Quad VCA / Mixer

Four VCAs with a sum output

Four linear VCAs with individual outputs plus a sum output with level control. Depending on patching it is a quad VCA, a four-channel mixer, or both.

  • Without a CV cable, LVL is a plain volume control
  • Patching an individual output removes that channel from the sum
  • Works with audio and control voltages
